q: We had to ___ the picnic because of the storm.
The fox was ___ to find its way out of the maze.
I can't ___ up with this noise any longer!
Can you ___ after my plants while I'm away?
The journey took longer than we ___.
explain: longer than expected = longer than we thought.

q: She ___ a promise to return before sunset.
The castle guard was very ___; he never let anyone break the rules.
We need to ___ a decision soon.
I'm really ___ forward to the festival.
explain: look forward to = be excited about something in the future.

q: The old bridge is ___ — please don't cross it.
Which word means the same as 'enormous'?
The wizard's ___ was that it would rain for a week.
explain: A prediction says what will happen.

q: Could you ___ me how to get to the lake?
explain: tell someone something; 'explain me' is a common mistake.

q: He ___ the bus, so he walked to the village.
explain: miss a bus = arrive too late to catch it.

q: That song ___ me of my summer holidays.
We've run ___ of milk. Can you buy some?
explain: run out of = have none left.
